verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no documented core/thread counts, clock/boost specs, or independent multi-core CPU benchmarks (e.g., Cinebench, compile-time tests) for the Ryzen AI Max+ 395; it focuses almost entirely on the AI/NPU software stack (ONNX Runtime, Vitis AI EP, Lemonade SDK, GAIA) and LLM token-per-second community reports rather than compiler/parallel-job CPU throughput. Community comments even note that available benchmarks compare the wrong components and give no real buying guidance, but this is about benchmark relevance, not a documented CPU performance claim being contradicted.
